reviewedBy: Claude Opus 5.5 (agent), for Nino Chavez; two cold-review subagents on device captures
method: Walked the Shot Bot chat on the home page in a local wrangler pages dev build (VITE_CHAT_ENABLED=true, OpenRouter google/gemini-2.5-flash, live Supabase). Headless Playwright captures at 375, 768 and 1440 wide: launcher (Find photos label from 640px up), open panel with suggestions, waiting, results after a real search (12 photos each, panel inside the viewport, reply text above the grid, view opens at the reply's start); 429 and stream-error states on phone with Try again, which re-sends one question. Copy checked as rendered: welcome, suggestions, plain model reply, 'N photos. Tap one to open it.', event-name tile labels, alt text from alt_text then caption (same order as PhotoCard; live tiles showed alt_text sentences), error lines; REC badge, notification dot and ISO 800 decoration removed. First tile link resolved 200. Live probes: jailbreak and prompt-leak prompts declined; the output guardrail replaced a reply naming an internal service. Two cold reviews read the frames; both rounds of fixes applied and recaptured. Not covered: a real iPhone or Android device (Playwright emulation only), on-screen keyboard behavior, screen-reader output, Escape/back-button closing, pages other than the home route, and production (flag stays off).
